description: The Hayom Yom entry for a civil date (default: today in Jerusalem). Hayom Yom is the Rebbe's calendar of daily Chassidus teachings, one short entry per Hebrew calendar day. Note: the Jewish day begins at nightfall, so after dark the next day's entry applies.

date.description: Civil date, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today in Jerusalem.

language.description: Entry language: en, he, es, fr, ru, yi. Default en.
